title_cn: 穆昆达表示，加州知道什么能激发商业创新
summary:
California is leading a group of states suing to block Paramount Skydance Corp.'s purchase of Warner Bros Discovery Inc., claiming the deal would give the combined company unfair control of movie and cable-TV businesses.
Paramount executives have responded by threatening to pull its operations out of California, while Google co-founder Sergey Brin is fighting a proposed wealth tax in the state that could cost him more than $13 billion. Bloomberg Opinion Columnist, and Lecturer at Yale School of Management Gautam Mukunda joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Burnham Vows ‘Huge Transfer of Power’ From Treasury to No. 10 North
title_cn: 伯纳姆誓言从财政部向北十号进行“巨大的权力转移”
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham said he will shift responsibility for economic growth away from the UK Treasury and toward his new office in the north of England.

title: UAE Adds to Pressure on Iran After Missiles Target Territory
title_cn: 导弹瞄准领土后，阿联酋加大对伊朗的压力
summary: The United Arab Emirates has cut all economic ties with Tehran after accusing Iran of firing ballistic missiles at its territory, ramping up regional tensions.

title: DOJ Maintains Comey Seashells Post Was Threat to Trump’s Life
title_cn: 司法部维持科米贝壳帖子对特朗普的生命构成威胁
summary: The Justice Department is doubling down on its prosecution of James Comey, pushing back on the former FBI director’s assertion that a 2025 social media post wasn’t intended as a threat to President Donald Trump.

title: Germany Condemns Israeli Minister’s ‘Dehumanizing’ Comments
title_cn: 德国谴责以色列部长的“非人化”言论
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz forcefully condemned comments by an Israeli cabinet minister, who called for nightly assassinations in Gaza despite US-led efforts to halt fighting in the war-racked Palestinian territory.

title: North Korea Denies Kim Talks as Trump Seeks Meeting This Year
title_cn: 特朗普寻求今年会晤，朝鲜否认金正恩会谈
summary: North Korea denied any direct communication between Kim Jong Un and President Donald Trump even as the US president said he’s seeking to meet with the strongman this year.
